title: 고준위 방사성폐기물 관리위원회 직제 / queue:ARTICLE:9:0:00009:part:1/1

Article 9 (Personnel Quotas of Public Officials Assigned to the Commission)
(1) The number of public officials assigned to the Commission shall be as specified in the attached Table.
(2) The number of public officials by grade assigned to the Commission shall be prescribed by the chairperson through directives, established rules, or other methods. In such cases, the upper limit for Grade IV public officials (including positions graded III or IV) shall be three persons; the upper limit for positions graded III or IV shall be one third of the quota for Grade IV officials (including positions graded III or IV); and the upper limit for positions graded IV or V shall be one third of the quota for Grade V officials (including positions graded IV or V).
(3) Of the public officials assigned to the Commission, one person (Grade IV or V) shall be filled by a public official belonging to the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment, one person (Grade V) by a public official belonging to the Ministry of Science and ICT, and one person (Grade V) by a public official belonging to the Nuclear Safety and Security Commission. In such cases, the chairperson shall consult in advance with the heads of the relevant agencies concerning the methods and procedures for filling such positions. [Amended on October 1, 2025.]
